caption: The drawing is composed mainly of a symmetrical pastoral scene featuring a central large building that is pink with a yellow arched door, ten black windows, and two red chimneys. On either side of the building, there are identical trees with green leaves and brown trunks, forming arches over two human figures; the left figure is dressed in green, holding a shepherd’s crook, and the right figure is dressed in red with striped details and also holds a staff. Between each human figure and the central building there are tall, red-and-green stylized plants. In front of the building, there are two large black-and-white dogs lying down, surrounded by several small white sheep scattered across a green and blue patterned ground. At the bottom left and right corners, there are red baskets filled with multicolored flowers, mostly pink, yellow, and white with green foliage. Above the building, a large multicolored moth or butterfly is centered, with tan, pink, and yellow details. Flanking this central motif are two pink cherubs with blue wings, each blowing a gold trumpet and facing inward. In the upper corners are two stylized sun or rosette symbols in red. Near the center-top, there is a block of text rendered in black, and at the bottom center, the name "Sarah Sutlert" and a year (1847) are stitched in gray. The overall color palette consists of muted reds, greens, pinks, blues, yellows, black, and white, arranged in a balanced, decorative composition.
